title: Uniform quasi-coherent sheaf vanishing over affine etale charts
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$, with their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Assume that $Y$ is quasi-compact, that $f$ is quasi-compact (each pullback over an affine scheme has quasi-compact source), and that its relative diagonal is quasi-compact. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and quasi-coherence [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. For an affine etale scheme $V\to Y$, put $W=X\times_YV$. Extend a module $M$ from the small etale site of $X$ to the enlarged etale site $\mathcal C_X$ of [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model], and denote its extension by $\widetilde M$. Define the additive functor $F_V:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Ab}$ by $F_V(M)=\widetilde M(W)$, forgetting the section ring action. Write $R^pF_V(M)$ for degree $p$ cohomology after applying $F_V$ to an injective resolution in all module sheaves. There exists an integer $N\geq1$, depending only on $f$, such that $R^pF_V(M)=0$ for every affine etale $V\to Y$, every quasi-coherent $M$ on $X$, and every integer $p\geq N$. No Noetherian, finite-type, finite-presentation or coherence hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 073G (lemma-vanishing-higher-direct-images), combined with Tag 08EX (lemma-quasi-coherence-higher-direct-images-application); exactly the sheaf-cohomology bound used in spaces-perfect.tex Tag 08FA, proof of (2).

proof.text: Choose once and for all an affine scheme $T$ and a surjective etale map $a:T\to Y$ using [lem-sfb-qc-space-affine-etale-atlas]. Put $Z=X\times_YT$ and $g:Z\to T$. By [lem-sfb-space-quasicompact-affine-tests], $g$ is quasi-compact. Its diagonal is the base change of $\Delta_f$, so the same node applied to $\Delta_f$ makes $g$ quasi-separated. Since $T$ is affine, it is quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs]; [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-source-products] then makes $Z$ quasi-separated. The affine-test hypothesis on $f$ makes $Z$ quasi-compact. The fibre products and etale projections exist by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. This argument applies also to the pullback of $f$ over any other affine scheme over $Y$. It requires no quasi-separatedness of $Y$.

source.place: Tag 073G, lemma-vanishing-higher-direct-images, reduction to an affine etale cover of Y.

proof.text: Apply the existing single-space bound [lem-sfb-space-global-sections-amplitude] to $Z$ and fix its integer $c\geq0$. Set $N=c+1$. For every quasi-coherent module $Q$ on $Z$, the object $Q[0]$ has quasi-coherent cohomology and lies in degrees $\leq0$, so $H^pR\Gamma(Z,Q[0])=0$ for $p\geq N$. This is also $H^p(Z,Q)$ in the module-injective convention: [lem-sfb-module-resolution-derived-presheaf-comparison] supplies a nonnegative injective module resolution, and [lem-weil-pbc-bounded-below-injectives-kinjective] makes that resolution K-injective. Thus the same section complex computes both expressions. The choice of $c$, and hence of $N$, depends on the one fixed space $Z$, not on $Q$.

source.place: Tag 072C, lemma-vanishing-quasi-separated; its single-space bound is supplied by the existing global-sections-amplitude node (spaces-perfect.tex Tag 08F7).

proof.text: For every such $Q$ and $p\geq N$, [lem-sfb-space-higher-direct-image-quasi-coherent] makes $A_p=R^pg_*Q$ quasi-coherent, and [lem-sfb-space-affine-base-higher-image-sections] gives $\Gamma(T,A_p)\cong H^p(Z,Q)=0$. By [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence], $A_p$ comes from a quasi-coherent Zariski module $B_p$ with the same global sections. The counit in [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] identifies $B_p$ with $\widetilde{\Gamma(T,B_p)}=\widetilde0=0$. Hence $A_p=0$. This proves $R^pg_*Q=0$ for all quasi-coherent $Q$ with the one bound $N$.

Now let $M$ be quasi-coherent on $X$. Its restriction $M_Z$ is quasi-coherent by [lem-sfb-space-module-pullback-quasicoherent]. By [lem-sfb-space-higher-image-etale-restriction], $(R^pf_*M)|_T\cong R^pg_*M_Z=0$ for $p\geq N$. This implies $R^pf_*M=0$: for an etale scheme object $U\to Y$, the scheme $U\times_YT$ is an etale surjective cover of $U$ by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Every section of $R^pf_*M$ over $U$ restricts to zero on that cover, so is zero by the separatedness axiom of a sheaf. This proves vanishing on every object of the small etale site of $Y$.

source.place: Tag 073G, lemma-vanishing-higher-direct-images, first paragraph: etale descent of higher direct images.

proof.text: For an arbitrary affine etale $V\to Y$, put $W=X\times_YV$ and $h:W\to V$. The base-change argument of step 1 gives that $h$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Its coefficient $M_W$ is quasi-coherent by [lem-sfb-space-module-pullback-quasicoherent]. By [lem-sfb-space-higher-image-etale-restriction] and step 4, $R^ph_*M_W\cong(R^pf_*M)|_V=0$ for $p\geq N$. Apply [lem-sfb-space-affine-base-higher-image-sections] to $h$ to obtain $H^p(W,M_W)\cong\Gamma(V,R^ph_*M_W)=0$. The integer $N$ was fixed before choosing $V$ or $M$.

source.place: Tag 08EX, lemma-quasi-coherence-higher-direct-images-application, applied after etale base change.

proof.text: It remains to identify the functor actually stated in the item. A nonnegative injective module resolution exists by [lem-sfb-module-resolution-derived-presheaf-comparison]. The module equivalence in [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model] carries it to an injective resolution on $\mathcal C_X$, by [lem-weil-pbc-equivalence-injective-resolutions]. Consequently $R^pF_V(M)$ is derived module evaluation of $\widetilde M$ at the object $W$ on this enlarged site. By [lem-pe-ringed-site-derived-evaluation-slice] this is $H^p(\mathcal C_X/W,\widetilde M_{ab}|_W)$, computed in abelian sheaves. The enlarged-site model identifies this ringed slice with $\mathcal C_W$, with the coefficient given by the extension of $M_W$. The comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-site-module-abelian-evaluation-comparison], applied to the terminal object of $\mathcal C_W$, identifies its abelian cohomology with module global-section cohomology there. Finally, the module equivalence between $\mathcal C_W$ and $W_{\mathrm{et}}$ preserves injective resolutions and global sections, again by [lem-weil-pbc-equivalence-injective-resolutions]. Thus $R^pF_V(M)\cong H^p(W,M_W)$, and step 5 proves the assertion. No underlying additive sheaf of an injective module was assumed injective. Empty spaces and zero modules give zero section complexes; $N\geq1$ keeps all asserted degrees nonnegative.

lean.note: F_V is the actual normalized enlarged-module extension followed by additive section evaluation at the base-changed scheme chart. Right derivation is in all modules on the already recorded equivalent small affine model, retaining section universe u; no derived category of QCoh is used. The positive natural bound and natural degrees encode exactly the integer degrees >= N >= 1. Quasi-compactness of Y uses the existing IsQuasiCompact predicate, owned by def-sfb-stack-qcqs-morphism. The affine-test and diagonal predicates are cited through their existing definition nodes, not the etale-locality theorem.
